name: Lila
source:
She studies the last year of History with Pol. She’s been a good friend and confident of Pol and Tirs since they met in their first year of Uni. She’s extroverted and easy-going, and loves partying and meeting new people. Tirs sometimes is sure she’s able to read their minds.

(From Casting Call)
